A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same MoESD study and provide readable text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices. The original proof and parameter-fitting appendix can be matched across relocation and renumbering.

before.justification: Section 4 reports original GPU timings, speculative-decoding speedups, and modeling validation. Appendix B reports experiments varying the measurements used for fitting.

after.justification: V3 retains these original experiments and adds Mixtral/EAGLE results, additional GPU configurations, individual timing runs, end-to-end comparisons, and operator profiling.

M1.justification: The proposed speedup model, Algorithm 1, target-efficiency calculation, and least-squares fitting procedure are retained. Mixtral/EAGLE is an additional evaluation configuration; no revision to the proposed modeling procedure is stated.

E1.justification: Both versions use HumanEval for code generation and MT-bench for conversation, including the expert-activation measurements in Figure 1. Additional models and GPU configurations do not introduce new datasets or task requirements.

E2.justification: Autoregressive decoding and the OPT-30B/OPT-350M dense-model reference are retained. Mixtral/EAGLE provides another MoE target/draft configuration for validating the analysis; no new competing acceleration or modeling baseline is introduced.

E3.justification: Section 4 adds Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct-v0.1 with an EAGLE speculation head and expands hardware settings to include 4xGPU-A and 4xGPU-C. Appendix A.2 adds end-to-end OPT-versus-Qwen2 comparisons across temperatures and draft lengths alongside the retained target-efficiency comparison.

E4.justification: V3 adds temperature/draft-length sensitivity of MoE-versus-dense speedups in Appendix A.2 and an FFN-versus-attention profiling case study in Appendix C.1. The original expert-count analysis and extensive fitting-measurement sensitivity study are retained.

E5.justification: Both versions average the last five of ten runs. Appendix A.1 newly states that the random seed is fixed and Figure 5 displays individual runs with their averages. This adds repeatability evidence without establishing additional runs or introducing formal significance tests or confidence intervals.

E6.justification: V3 adds Mixtral/EAGLE results, four-GPU results, end-to-end dense/MoE comparisons, and operator timings. It also revises OPT-30B's target-efficiency curve: at batch size 48, approximately 0.31 in v1 Figure 2(c) becomes 0.39 in v3 Figure 3. Original Qwen2 table entries, including the 2.29x peak, and fitting MSE values are retained.

T1.justification: The definitions, uniform-routing assumptions, Equations 1–14, and expert-workload monotonicity proof are retained. The proof moves from Appendix A to Appendix B; the added modeling overview introduces no new mathematical result.

C1.justification: The central moderate-batch, sparsity, target-efficiency, modeling, and 2.29x claims remain unchanged. The introduction additionally claims applicability to latency-critical serving, modestly extending the stated deployment scope.

C2.justification: V3 explains reduced relative speedup with additional GPUs, attributes local fluctuations to GPU tile effects, and develops the rationale for empirical profiling. Section 3.4 also qualifies small-batch inefficiency under extensive expert parallelism. Existing KV-cache and FFN-dominance limitations remain.

D1.justification: V3 newly discloses that the small draft model remains on one GPU during target-model parallelization and supplies hidden sizes for the profiling example. However, it removes v1's explicit FP16 and 80 GB GPU-memory information. The fitting optimizer, sampling procedure, and substantive parameter-bound information are retained.

R1.justification: V3 adds citations concerning MoE-specific speculative decoding, TurboSpec and batching, serving objectives, Mixtral, GPU performance, FlashAttention-3, and NanoFlow. These extend the supporting literature without substantially redefining the paper's research positioning.

P1.justification: The introduction, practical-value discussion, and experimental narrative receive localized rewrites and expansions. V3 adds a modeling overview and reorganizes the appendices around supplementary results, the retained proof, and fitting details. The main section sequence and most theoretical exposition remain intact.

P2.justification: The empirical displays are substantially expanded and reorganized: v1 Table 1 becomes two expanded tables, Figure 2 gains a Mixtral panel, and its former panel (c) becomes Figure 3 with explicit model labels. New Figures 5–7 show individual runs, end-to-end comparisons, and the modeling workflow. The original fitting plots are retained and renumbered.

improvement.justification: Mixtral/EAGLE, additional GPU configurations, and direct dense/MoE speedup comparisons strengthen support for the retained generality claims. The modeling overview and profiling rationale improve clarity. These provide a modest net gain, tempered by removal of FP16/80 GB hardware details and uncertainty evidence limited to fixed-seed timing repetitions.
